svg.aria-label: Convert SAFEs at the priced round
svg.title: Convert SAFEs at the priced round
svg.desc: When the priced round closes, every outstanding SAFE converts to preferred stock: pull the notes and side letters, model the conversion math (caps, discounts, pro-rata rights), confirm the mechanics with counsel, execute the conversion on the cap-table platform, and tell the new stockholders what they own. The round documents themselves are signed in Close a priced equity round.
